title: Experts disagree on session-start refresh in runtime/hooks/agent-entry-session-start.mjs
context:
Chief architect: The two claims do not really fight: the security claim says what may be written, the QA claim says how errors stay silent. It is a pick only because a must-level security finding is involved. Recommend the security claim and build the QA error path with it (one log line, nothing printed, exit 0, no write when nothing differs); the owner can confirm both in one click.

Target: session-start refresh in runtime/hooks/agent-entry-session-start.mjs
- security-auditor: The refresh writes agent and recipe content only from the installed paqad package, never from files in the project, and never writes through a symlink: a .claude/agents/paqad-*.md or paqad-*/ skills folder that is a symlink is skipped and logged, so a planted link cannot make paqad overwrite a file outside the folder.
- qa-engineer: Error path: when the agents folder is unwritable or rendering throws, the hook writes one line to the launcher log, prints nothing to the session and exits 0; when nothing differs it writes no file (mtime unchanged); proof_type unit.
